projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description: Full-stack real-time messaging platform providing instant bi-directional STOMP/SockJS communication over WebSockets, reactive MongoDB persistence, and active presence tracking.
impact: Engineered low-latency bidirectional chat streaming supporting 100+ concurrent socket connections over STOMP/SockJS.
Integrated reactive MongoDB persistence layer, delivering sub-50ms message storage and chat history retrieval.
Deployed modular React.js user interface featuring live presence indicators and auto-reconnecting socket sessions.

projects.title: BudgetWise – Smart Personal Finance Manager
projects.description: Comprehensive personal financial management application featuring stateless JWT authentication, fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC), transaction tracking, and dynamic visual analytics.
impact: Developed stateless RESTful micro-services with Spring Boot and JWT security, securing 15+ API endpoints with RBAC.
Engineered relational MySQL database schema with optimized indexing for multi-category transaction analytics.
Integrated interactive visual dashboards using React and Chart.js for real-time spending insights.

projects.title: IRCTC Backend – Railway Ticket Booking System
projects.description: Enterprise-grade railway reservation backend handling train scheduling, seat allocation workflows, dynamic waitlist management, automated queue ordering, and multi-tier fare calculation.
impact: Designed ACID-compliant transaction manager handling concurrent seat reservations and automated waitlist priority queues.
Implemented multi-tier fare calculation algorithm and train route lookup using optimized MySQL queries.
Enforced role-based authentication separating administrator capabilities from passenger management actions.

projects.title: FundChain – Decentralized Crowdfunding Platform
projects.description: Trustless decentralized crowdfunding platform leveraging Ethereum smart contracts for transparent milestone-based campaign creation, contribution tracking, and automated fund releases.
impact: Authored and tested Ethereum smart contracts in Solidity for trustless milestone-based fund releasing.
Integrated Web3.js with MetaMask wallet authentication and dynamic React frontend for live campaign state updates.

projects.title: TechSight – Agentic Financial Research Analyst
projects.description: Autonomous multi-agent financial research assistant that ingests SEC 10-K filings, executes multi-step financial ratio analysis, retrieves relevant disclosures via vector search, and measures response quality.
impact: Built a multi-agent LangGraph workflow reducing financial report analysis time from hours to under 30 seconds.
Optimized vector retrieval using ChromaDB & AWS S3 with LoRA fine-tuning, achieving 94% retrieval accuracy and near-zero hallucination rate evaluated via RAGAs.
Delivered interactive research interface allowing custom query execution over complex financial SEC 10-K filings.

projects.title: Unified LLM Gateway – Production-Grade AI Proxy Service
projects.description: High-performance multi-provider LLM proxy service featuring standard OpenAI API shape compatibility, two-layer caching (exact SHA-256 and semantic cosine similarity), provider fallback routing, and token cost metering.
impact: Implemented two-layer caching (exact SHA-256 and semantic cosine similarity threshold 0.92 in Redis), reducing API latency by up to 85% for repeat queries.
Built automatic provider failover and budget-enforcing token cost metering across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Groq endpoints.
Exposed Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for real-time throughput, error rate, and token spending analytics.

projects.title: MedRAG – Modular Medical Document Processing & Information Service
projects.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system specialized for clinical & medical document QA, processing PDF/DOCX/TXT files with strict context constraint to prevent medical hallucinations.
impact: Built an end-to-end medical document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF/DOCX/TXT files using OCR and hybrid retrieval (FAISS/ChromaDB).
Enforced strict context-constrained prompt boundaries, eliminating external knowledge hallucination on medical queries.
Integrated AWS Glue and SQL data transformation pipelines to structure unstructured clinical data for high-precision query answering.

projects.title: FinMCP – MCP Server for Real-Time Financial Intelligence
projects.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server delivering real-time financial market data, SEC filings, and data warehouse integration directly to LLM agent orchestrators.
impact: Developed an MCP-compliant tool server integrating yFinance and SEC EDGAR APIs for agentic market intelligence retrieval.
Connected Amazon S3 and Redshift data warehouses to serve historical stock metrics and SEC 10-K/10-Q financial statements.
Standardized JSON-RPC protocol interfaces allowing seamless tool consumption by LangChain/LangGraph agent runtimes.

projects.title: Violence Detection with Explainable AI
projects.description: Computer vision deep learning system for automated video surveillance violence detection featuring Grad-CAM explainability heatmaps and automated Telegram incident alerting.
impact: Achieved 92.4% detection accuracy on surveillance video clips using MobileNetV2 spatial feature extractor combined with LSTM temporal sequence modeling.
Integrated Grad-CAM explainable AI heatmaps to visually highlight regions triggering high-confidence violence predictions.
Implemented real-time video stream ingestion via OpenCV with automated Telegram bot alert notifications.
